description:
FILED s473t3 (Opus triage of the 79 CATALOG-only blessed rows), on main
d9a2aac0.  PRE-EXISTING.  Probe: scratch/s473t3/probes/p12*.pl and the
11-line harness reproducer below.

ROW BEHIND IT (baselines/fail-baseline.tsv, 1 row):
  length.t 34 (UNNAMED row; got '', expected undef)
  -- perl-tests/length.t:139, `is($u, undef);`

REPRODUCER -- must run under the TAP harness (`tools/runt`), because the
divergence is in the harness, not in the value:
    #!./perl
    use warnings; use strict;
    BEGIN { chdir 't' if -d 't'; require "./test.pl"; }
    plan(tests => 2);
    require Tie::Scalar;
    my $u = "Gotcha!";
    tie $u, "Tie::StdScalar";
    print STDERR "# DBG defined=", (defined($u)?1:0), "\n";
    is($u, undef);
    is(1,1);
  PCL:  `# DBG defined=0`  then  `not ok 1 / got: '' / expected: undef`
  perl: both rows ok.
  The two lines CONTRADICT EACH OTHER inside one program: the program's own
  `defined` says undef, the harness's `is` says defined ''.

MECHANISM, read at the site: `cl/pcl-test.lisp:396`
    (defun test-undef-p (x)
      (or (null x) (eq x *p-undef*)
          (and (p-box-p x)
               (let ((v (p-box-value x)))
                 (or (null v) (eq v *p-undef*))))))
For a tied scalar the box's value is a `p-tie-proxy` struct, so the `or`
falls through and the row is treated as defined; `to-string` (used for the
`got:` line and for the comparison) DOES run FETCH and yields "".  Every
`is`/`isnt`/`ok`-family assertion in `cl/pcl-test.lisp` that calls
`test-undef-p` has the same hole.  The fix is to route through the accessor
that fires get-magic (`unbox`) before deciding.

BAR IF FIXED (CLAUDE.md WHAT-TO-RUN-WHEN, the "harness" row): full sweep YES
+ companion `--all --quick` (both populations reach it) + baselines edited
ROW BY ROW.  That price is why s473t3 filed it rather than shipping it.

CATALOG NOTE THIS REPLACES: sweep-bug-catalog.md length.t, "`length(undef)`
on a tied scalar (test 34): tie FETCH returns `''` not `undef`.  Tie
semantics, not the plain-undef path" -- MEASURED WRONG: the value path is
correct in PCL (`defined`, a copy, `@_`, a `($$@)`-prototyped sub and a
cross-file sub all report undef); only the harness's undef test is wrong.

FAMILY: `docs/tap-assertion-audit.md` (#202) -- the inventory of what the TAP
layer can and cannot claim.  This is a claim it gets WRONG, not one it cannot
make.
subject: BUG (HARNESS, cl/pcl-test.lisp): `test-undef-p` reads `p-box-value` RAW, so a TIED scalar whose FETCH returns undef is judged DEFINED -- `is($tied_undef, undef)` reports `got: ''` while `defined($tied_undef)` in the same program is false
